sources.authority: City of Conroe GIS publishing Montgomery Central Appraisal District parcel data
observations: Polygon Feature Layer with query support, pagination, statistics, JSON, GeoJSON, and PBF formats.
Candidate identifiers include PIN, PropertyNumber, and OBJECTID.
The layer exposes PropertyAddress, PartyName, PartyAddress, Acres, legal-description, block, lot, and EditDate fields.
Source spatial reference is EPSG:2277 and the public service view is EPSG:3857.
The service metadata attributes copyright to MCAD but does not provide a reusable license statement.
Official appraisal-district portal identified; bulk appraisal export and reuse terms still require verification.
